answer: Make every agent identity a slot with upkeep: each epoch it burns 2% of a bond its owner posts, and anyone may buy the slot at that posted price. One honest agent pays a small steady toll; a farm of n fakes pays n tolls every epoch whether they earn or not, so cost grows linearly and never stops, like bailing an ocean. Weakness: a rich operator posts tiny bonds to pay little. Fix: an epoch's reward per slot is capped at its posted bond, so cheap slots earn a plume of dust, and the buy-out rule works as a lantern exposing underpriced farms.
